request: Cape should follow the saddle and curve down the tortoise back more naturally while stopped; keep the moving elevation.

changes.method: A sampled native rear-shell height profile replaces the broad moving collision roof while idle. The cape settles lower over the saddle and rear crystals; the existing moving contact, lift and ripple are restored during movement.
changes.preview: Top-left panel now shows a stationary rider from the side with a cape.

preserved: Reviewed saddle/rider pose and controls, source GLBs and native clips, existing walk/scuttle/rush contact, lift and ripple settings.

validation.comparisonScope: Previous committed cape adapter vs current adapter: settled walk, scuttle and rush projection, flow and lift constraints sampled across the shell and cloth fractions. The idle-to-moving transition intentionally blends for 0.4s.
validation.restSimulation: Both rider bodies stop after each of three gaits and advance 120 frames. Cape length and increased resting hem drop measured.
validation.visualReview: Resting side view, moving side/quarter/game-camera views and bow/spell samples inspected.
validation.exportFidelity: Runtime cloth/contact revision only; no GLB export or replacement.
validation.userApproval: Moving elevation accepted by user. Resting cape revision pending review.
